ev.q: Retrospective analyses indicated that WWS detected enterovirus D68 (EV-D68) ≤1 month before syndromic and clinical laboratory signals.
During 2022–23, wastewater sampling covered a large proportion of the sites' populations: 94% (Houston, Texas), 67% (California), 65% (Colorado), and 50% (Wisconsin).
Retrospective analyses indicated that WWS detected enterovirus D68 (EV-D68) ≤1 month before syndromic and clinical laboratory signals.
This report highlights the use of wastewater data by the four National Wastewater Surveillance System's (NWSS) Centers of Excellence
